description: This file defines the `AllocatorConfig.h` header for the c10::CachingAllocator namespace, including constants, a ConfigTokenizer class for parsing configuration strings, and the `AcceleratorAllocatorConfig` class for managing memory allocation settings for device and host memory, with support for environment variable parsing and hooks for backend-specific extensions.

classes.name: ConfigTokenizer
classes.description: Utility class for tokenizing allocator configuration strings into discrete parts, supporting parsing of key-value pairs, lists, and different data types.

classes.name: AcceleratorAllocatorConfig
classes.description: Singleton class that manages memory allocation configuration for device and host, including environment variable parsing, key validation, and hooks for backend-specific extensions.

methods.name: parseArgs
methods.description: Parses environment variable string to update allocator settings.

methods.name: large_segment_size
methods.description: Returns the size of large memory segments in bytes.

methods.name: max_split_size
methods.description: Returns the maximum size (in MB) allowed for splitting memory blocks.

methods.name: max_non_split_rounding_size
methods.description: Returns the maximum size (in MB) for rounding up allocations without splitting.

methods.name: roundup_power2_divisions
methods.description: Returns division factors for rounding up allocation sizes.

methods.name: garbage_collection_threshold
methods.description: Returns the threshold ratio to trigger garbage collection.

methods.name: use_expandable_segments
methods.description: Indicates if expandable segments are enabled.

methods.name: pinned_use_background_threads
methods.description: Indicates if background threads are used for pinned host allocator.

methods.name: last_allocator_settings
methods.description: Returns the last set of allocator settings as a string.

methods.name: registerDeviceConfigParserHook
methods.description: Registers a hook for parsing device-specific allocator configuration options.

methods.name: callDeviceConfigParserHook
methods.description: Invokes the registered device-specific configuration parser hook.
